The user wants an extended, detailed engineering tutorial on designing a reliable service based on the provided document. The document is extremely repetitive (just the same sentence repeated hundreds of times): "A reliable service records requests, validates inputs, processes jobs and handles failures."

I need to write a comprehensive engineering tutorial (at least 1500 words) covering:
1. Designing this service
2. Examples
3. Failure analysis
4. Testing

The core service has four responsibilities:
- Records requests (ingestion, persistence, idempotency)
- Validates inputs (schema, business rules, authz)
- Processes jobs
